Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Delights Deli specializes in the preparation and sale of high-quality sandwiches, salads, and artisanal deli products. Our operations include a limited kitchen area equipped with household-type appliances, allowing us to focus on assembling fresh ingredients without extensive cooking. We prioritize food safety and proper handling of perishable items, ensuring compliance with local health regulations. The establishment has a welcoming atmosphere for dine-in customers, while also offering takeout services. We maintain strict employee safety protocols to minimize the risk of injuries in food preparation. Additionally, we offer catering services for small events and parties, providing customized sandwich platters and gourmet snacks. With an annual gross revenue of less than $500,000, we aim to deliver exceptional products while managing operational risks effectively.
